purpose: Machine-readable mirror of V52 package route classifier; no package analysis and no evidence added.

routes.forbidden_use: do not tune V22 threshold or reinterpret unplanned endpoints
routes.package_signal: paired baseline plus early on-treatment PBMC expression with response labels
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if baseline or early sample is absent; reject if response label is absent; reject if V22 module coverage fails
routes.route_if_partial: allow reduced-trust monitoring run if steroid/cell-count metadata are missing but pairing labels coverage and batch checks are scoreable

routes.forbidden_use: do not promote GPR25 or KIF21B to target-ready from association alone
routes.package_signal: genotype-linked immune or CSF molecular package for chr1 locus
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if genotype-to-readout link is absent; reject if candidate gene readout is absent; context-only if cell state is not interpretable
routes.route_if_partial: allow causal-gene or direction-only handoff if perturbation is absent but genotype-to-readout link is intact

routes.forbidden_use: do not treat inhibition knockdown or degradation as rescue when restoration is required
routes.next_action: update docs/reports/THERAPEUTIC_REOPEN_CHECKLIST_V52.tsv only after all gates are met
routes.package_signal: direction-matched perturbation package for resolved chr1 gene
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if candidate gene is unresolved; reject if protective direction is missing; context-only if phenotype is not MS-relevant
routes.route_if_partial: allow control-only classification if modality deliberately moves opposite to protective direction

routes.forbidden_use: do not convert postpartum biology into a therapeutic target or monitoring rule
routes.next_action: run preregistered postpartum harness if available
routes.package_signal: postpartum MS relapse-window immune trajectory package
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if no MS postpartum samples; reject if relapse-window endpoint is absent; context-only if APC-axis coverage fails
routes.route_if_partial: allow confounded-secondary-biology class if core timing and axis coverage are present but DMT/steroid metadata are incomplete

routes.forbidden_use: do not claim within-cell remodeling when only composition changed
routes.next_action: run preregistered T/B harness if available
routes.package_signal: T/B compartment remodeling or monitoring package
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if T/B resolution is absent; reject if composition shift is unseparable for the proposed claim
routes.route_if_partial: allow limited secondary class if compartment labels and timing exist but composition metadata are partial

routes.forbidden_use: do not count as treatment-response validation
routes.next_action: record pharmacodynamic context and keep validation status unchanged
routes.package_signal: treatment-timed expression or immune profile without response labels
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: context-only if response labels are absent or not pre-specified; reject if timing is absent
routes.route_if_partial: allow within-subject delta context if subject pairing is present but labels are absent

routes.forbidden_use: do not override causal-gene direction cell-state or modality blockers
routes.next_action: store in segregated structure context and update no-go table only if wording needs tightening
routes.package_signal: protein structure or tractability package tied to a lead
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject if source version or confidence metrics are missing; reject if used as disease evidence
routes.route_if_partial: allow feasibility note only when source version and confidence are complete

routes.forbidden_use: do not inspect restricted content before allowed-use status is clear
routes.next_action: request terms clarification or a permitted derivative package
routes.package_signal: package cannot be used because terms or access constraints are unresolved
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject for active analysis if terms forbid local analysis or redistribution
routes.route_if_partial: route to blocked pending human/legal decision if metadata exists but terms are unclear

routes.forbidden_use: do not infer validation performance from aggregate-only evidence
routes.next_action: record acquisition gap and request sample-level package
routes.package_signal: metadata summary aggregate plot or paper table without sample-level scoreable data
routes.reject_or_context_only_if: reject for validation if sample-level expression pairing labels or genotype links are unavailable
routes.route_if_partial: route to context-only if it clarifies acquisition path or cohort feasibility
